MUSIC AND DANCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MUSIC AND DANCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Kenyan Folk Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Songs.
   C. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Songs.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Songs.

2. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

3. Best practice when working on Setting Text to Music: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Setting Text to Music.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Setting Text to Music.
   C. Practise Setting Text to Music with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Setting Text to Music.

4. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

5. Best practice when working on Transposition: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Transposition.
   B. Damage equipment used for Transposition.
   C. Practise Transposition with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Transposition.

6. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. Only the volume
   C. Only the costume
   D. The speed of the music

7. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins.
   B. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins.
   D. Practise Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Best practice when working on Dance Production: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Dance Production with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Dance Production.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Dance Production.
   D. Damage equipment used for Dance Production.

9. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem.
   C. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem.

10. Best practice when working on Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;.
   C. Practise Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines; with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;.

11. Best practice when working on Melody in Major Keys: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Melody in Major Keys with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Melody in Major Keys.
   C. Damage equipment used for Melody in Major Keys.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Melody in Major Keys.

12. Best practice when working on Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song.
   B. Damage equipment used for Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song.
   D. Practise Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Contemporary Dances-Kenyan 3.0 Critical Appreciation 3.1 Kenyan Folk Songs 3.2 C and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Contemporary Dance from Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Folk Songs 3.2 Classical Music 3.3 Music and Dance in Socio-Cultural Cont and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Folk Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — Practise Kenyan Folk Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. D — Red, blue, and yellow

3. C — Practise Setting Text to Music with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. D — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

5. C — Practise Transposition with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. D — The speed of the music

7. D — Practise Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. A — Practise Dance Production with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. C — Practise Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. C — Practise Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines; with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. A — Practise Melody in Major Keys with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. D — Practise Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Contemporary Dances-Kenyan 3.0 Critical Appreciation 3.1 Kenyan Folk Songs 3.2 C; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Contemporary Dance from Kenya; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Kenyan Folk Songs 3.2 Classical Music 3.3 Music and Dance in Socio-Cultural Cont; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Kenyan Folk Songs; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
